inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev14 CENTIPEDE, dev13 VERTEBRATE, dev12 UNKNOWN, dev11 BUTTERFLY, dev10 HORNET, dev9 ULTIMATE UFO, dev8 MANDALA and earlier native-format/mod/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev15 resolves GIGANTIC UFO complete visual hierarchy.

gigantic_ufo_runtime_assembly.cross_platform: retail Xbox + June 10 Xbox + retail PS3 preserve the same 1 root + 36 B5 locator-driven visual hierarchy

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 97/97 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and GIGANTIC UFO hierarchy checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: GIGANTIC UFO dev15 publishes the deterministic complete visual hierarchy; 0xB4 helper/control slots are not model assets and are deliberately excluded.
Fresh retail Xbox game data was used only for external validation; no proprietary package, GMX, or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
